title: 2015 book drive: Rs 37,500
summary: Raised Rs 37,500 from 9 contributions for books for rural schools.
what_would_have_happened: Children in rural schools start the year without enough notebooks and books.
the_call: Ask friends and colleagues every year, and send the money straight to a charity that buys and delivers the books.
what_i_did: Organized the drive, collected 9 contributions and passed them to Ekal Vidyalaya, which runs one-teacher schools in villages.
